title: Cozy Fall Clipart | Fall Fashion Clipart
author: prettyclementine
description:
Cozy Fall Clipart | Fall Fashion Clipart set by Pretty Clementine is an original hand-painted and carefully crafted clipart set. You can use the elements from this set for anything from digital planners, stickers, to social media branding for blogs and websites, stationery, wrapping paper, washi tape, scrapbooking, sublimation designs, and much more. 
—
**The set contains:**
– 19 separate elements with transparent backgrounds in PNG format
—
**Additional information:**
– You will receive files without a watermark. Watermark is there only on promo images.
– These files are compatible with most design and print software programs such as Adobe Photoshop, Adobe Illustrator, Canva, Procreate, Gimp, and more.
– This listing is for a digital download only.
